name: xTool P2S
tagline: Updated P2 with faster processing and improved autofocus
tldr: The P2S refines the original P2 with better software and autofocus. Same 55W CO₂ class for acrylic and wood production. Still xTool's main enclosed CO₂ below the P3 flagship : choose P3 if you need 80W and automation; P2S if 55W and budget fit.
mainObjective: Next-gen enclosed CO₂ for small businesses cutting acrylic and wood

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm acrylic

beginnerNotes: Only buy if you have confirmed CO₂ cutting needs and ventilation planned. Otherwise start with a diode.
proTips: Pair with xTool conveyor for batch work. LightBurn unlocks advanced nesting for sign shops.
primaryUse: Premium enclosed CO₂ for production cutting of acrylic and wood in small businesses.

editorialDepth.advantages: P2S refines the P2 experience with faster processing and improved autofocus while keeping the same 55W CO₂ class that sign makers expect. You still get enclosure safety, camera alignment, and a mature xTool ecosystem, often at a better bundle value than jumping straight to P3.
editorialDepth.limitations: All CO₂ caveats remain: ventilation, tube life, weight, and price. If you need 80W, a larger bed, or ACS automation, P3 is the meaningful upgrade, not P2S. Engraving-only buyers should not pay CO₂ money for diode-class work.
